- 2: two times

For the full date, I need ALL digits to appear even times. So in MMDD:
- 0 must appear odd times (1, 3,...)
- 2 must appear even times (0, 2, 4,...)  
- 3 must appear odd times (1, 3,...)
- All other digits even times (0, 2, 4,...)

Checking systematically:
